title: The Palace of Mirrored Glass
intro: Picture a distant land of wealth and splendor where the sun is worshipped instead of its Creator. A letter arrives bearing a call that cannot be ignored, and a journey begins toward a court greater than any seen before. There, illusion will be exposed by a floor that deceives the eyes, and a moment of clarity will change everything.
clues: I ruled over a prosperous land whose people prostrated to the sun instead of Allah.
I received a noble letter calling me not to exalt myself but to come in submission to Allah.
I consulted my council and chose diplomacy first, sending a gift to test the sender.
I came to Sulayman, and my own throne was presented to me disguised to test my recognition.
I entered a lofty palace whose smooth glass floor I mistook for deep water.
I declared my submission with Sulayman to Allah, Lord of the worlds.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: The Sister of Musa
The Wife of Abu Lahab
The Wife of Nuh
Bilqis, the Ruler of Saba
Zulaikha, the Wife of Al-Aziz

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Swallowed by a great fish in the depths of the sea
Struck by years of illness and loss of family
Ordered to sacrifice a beloved child in a dream
Tested by the disguised throne and the palace of glass
Thrown into a blazing fire for breaking idols
trial.answer: Tested by the disguised throne and the palace of glass

location.label: Key Element
options: The Ark built upon the waters
The cave of refuge for the sleepers
The crystal palace floor (Sarh)
The Nile River at the time of the exodus
The fire prepared by the idolaters

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Was swallowed by the earth with my treasures
Remained in disbelief and was destroyed with my people
Submitted with Sulayman to Allah, Lord of the worlds
Drowned in the sea while pursuing the believers
Was turned to stone for breaking the Sabbath
outcome.answer: Submitted with Sulayman to Allah, Lord of the worlds

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
